fr_html: Le Président a reçu des propositions de Lord Phillimore et de M. Adatci; M. Altamira va en déposer une et M. Loder a demandé la parole pour faire une communication.
en_html: The President had received proposals from Lord Phillimore and M. Adatci. M. Altamira was going to submit one, and M. Loder had asked to be allowed to make a communication to the meeting.
